from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

def compress(history: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    if len(history) <= {{max_turns}}:
        return history
    old, recent = history[:-{{max_turns}}], history[-{{max_turns}}:]
    text = "\n".join(f"{m['role']}: {m['content']}" for m in old)
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="{{model_name}}",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Summarize this convo briefly:\n{text}"}],
    )
    return [{"role": "system", "content": f"Earlier summary: {r.choices[0].message.content}"}] + recent
